title: Technical Data Analyst (AI & Python)
description:
Technical Data Analyst (AI & Python)

Location: London - 3 days a week onsite (non-negotiable)
Duration: 3 Month Initial Contract
Rate: £700-£800 per day Inside IR35 (flexible for the right candidate)

The Role

We're supporting Janus Henderson Investors in the search for an experienced Technical Data Analyst to join a specialist team delivering a major investment data migration programme. The team has developed an internal AI-powered analysis platform, built in Python, which is used to investigate data, support migration activities and provide intelligent insight to stakeholders across the business.

This role sits at the intersection of Data Analysis, Python Development and AI tooling. You'll be responsible for running and supporting the AI platform, analysing outputs, investigating data issues, triaging findings to relevant teams and helping improve the underlying Python codebase. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical analysis skills with the ability to engage confidently with business stakeholders and manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

The successful candidate will join a fast-paced environment where Python and AI expertise are the primary focus, supporting migration activities across multiple business areas while helping to further develop and enhance AI-assisted analytical capabilities.

Essential Experience

  • Extensive experience working as a Data Analyst within complex enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on Python experience, including writing, maintaining and improving Python code used for data analysis and investigation work
  • Advanced SQL skills, with experience tracing data lineage, comparing datasets, performing reconciliations and mapping data between systems
  • Experience working with AI, Generative AI, LLMs, AI-assisted analytics tools or Agentic AI solutions
  • Ability to investigate large volumes of data and distinguish genuine issues from expected differences during migration or testing activities
  • Experience working within shared codebases and version-controlled development environments
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both business and technology teams
  • Proven experience managing multiple requests, prioritising workloads and coordinating activities across stakeholders
  • Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, data quality, testing or platform transformation programmes

Desirable

  • Asset Management, Investment Management or broader Financial Services experience
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud-based data warehouse technologies
  • Experience building, enhancing or supporting AI-powered analytical tools
  • Knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and modern AI workflows
  • Exposure to Aladdin or similar investment management / OMS platforms
  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide data transformation or migration programmes
  • Understanding of investment, portfolio, performance or reference data domains

Please note: Candidates must be available to start within 3 weeks and be able to attend the London office 3 days per week.
